english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial verb for pondering or having a thought in mind.

exampleSentences.english: I think about whether to go see a movie tomorrow.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我諗緊聽日去唔去睇戲。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 gan2 ting1 jat6 heoi3 m4 heoi3 tai2 hei3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking about something, including whether to do it.

exampleSentences.english: I consider whether to go tomorrow.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 nam2 gan2 ting1 jat6 heoi3 m4 heoi3

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking carefully about something or reflecting on it.

exampleSentences.english: I took time to meditate on it before deciding whether to buy it.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我諗咗好耐，先至決定買唔買。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 nam2 zo2 hou2 noi6 sin1 zi3 kyut3 ding6 maai5 m4 maai5

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking carefully about something.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll ponder it first; I don’t want to answer you so quickly.
exampleSentences.traditional: 諗下先，我唔想咁快答你。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nam2 haa5 sin1 ngo5 m4 soeng2 gam3 faai3 daap3 nei5

english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for thinking carefully about something.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll mull over this when I get home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢件事我返到屋企再諗。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 faan2 dou3 uk1 kei2 zoi3 nam2

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for trying to work out or puzzling over a difficult matter.

exampleSentences.english: I need to puzzle over this problem for a while.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢條數真係要諗一陣先。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sou3 zan1 hai6 jiu3 nam2 jat1 zan6 sin1

english.note: Use this for thinking something over rather than physically chewing it.

exampleSentences.english: I’ll chew this matter over again when I get home.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢件事我返屋企再諗下先。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 gin6 si6 ngo5 faan1 uk1 kei2 zoi3 nam2 haa5 sin1
